title: ENAR Fostering Excellence in Biostatistics Workshop (FEBW) 2027
org: Eastern North American Region of the International Biometric Society (ENAR)
deadline_note: No registration deadline posted. The workshop is free and travel awards are available, but the page gives no amounts or award procedure.
dates: March 14, 2027 (check-in 9:45 AM; workshop 10:30 AM to 6:00 PM; Graduate School and Opportunities Expo 6:00 to 8:00 PM), Boston Marriott Copley Place
pay: Free; meal provided; travel awards available
eligibility: Students from broad-ranging backgrounds interested in biostatistics; no formal criteria posted
summary: One-day workshop held just before the ENAR Spring Meeting that introduces students to biostatistics careers. It ends with a graduate school and opportunities expo.

title: Biostatistics Summer Internship
org: Weill Cornell Medicine, Division of Biostatistics, Department of Population Health Sciences
deadline_note: No rolling admissions. Finalists are notified in early to mid March. The page does not say whether the application is open now.
pay: $5,000 stipend + dorm-style housing
eligibility: US students, citizens, and permanent residents; undergraduates or recent graduates who have not started graduate school (Dec 2026 and Spring 2027 graduates qualify); R experience preferred, not required; a few graduate-level TA spots
summary: Seven-week paid internship in biostatistics and data science at Weill Cornell Medicine in Manhattan. Interns receive training and do mentored research projects.

title: Summer Program in Biostatistics and Computational Biology
org: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
deadline_note: Not offered in 2026. The page (last modified Oct 16, 2025) says to check back in October 2026 for 2027 details. No 2027 deadline posted yet; decision letters go out in March.
dates: Six weeks in summer 2027; exact dates not posted
pay: Travel and living stipend covering lodging and some meals (amount not stated)
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents with health insurance; rising juniors, rising seniors, and recent graduates preferred; strong quantitative background with calculus; first- and second-year students accepted with lower preference
summary: Six-week program at the Harvard Chan School that introduces undergraduates to biostatistics and computational biology. It returns in 2027 after a pause in 2026.

title: Summer Institute in Biostatistics and Data Science (SIBS)
org: Boston University School of Public Health
deadline_note: 2026 final deadline was March 13, 2026 (rolling review, priority before March). 2027 dates not posted. NHLBI SIBS funding for 2027 is unconfirmed: the renewal notice RFA-HL-27-006 was archived July 29, 2026 with 'Applications are not being solicited at this time.'
dates: 2026: in residence June 8 to July 10, 2026; remote group project July 13 to mid-August 2026
pay: Stipend (amount not stated) + 4 college credits; tuition, travel, room and board covered
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; undergraduates or recent graduates in math, science, or quantitative fields; pre-med students not eligible
summary: NHLBI-funded SIBS site that combines a five-week residential course in Boston with a remote group research project. Participants earn college credit.

title: Summer Institute for Training in Biostatistics and Data Science at Columbia (SIBDS)
org: Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health
deadline_note: 2026 deadline was March 13, 2026 (rolling review). 2027 dates not posted. NIH SIBS funding for 2027 is unconfirmed (grant R25HL161786; renewal RFA-HL-27-006 archived July 2026).
dates: 2026: May 25 to July 10, 2026 (May 25 to 29 asynchronous; move-in May 31)
pay: Small stipend (amount not stated); free housing, travel, and most meals; no tuition
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents (international students not eligible); at least 2 years of undergraduate study completed, or community college enrollment as specified; advanced undergraduates and select recent graduates
summary: NIH-funded summer institute at Columbia Mailman with coursework and research in biostatistics and data science. Housing and travel are covered and participants earn college credit.

title: Florida's Summer Institute in Biostatistics and Data Science (SIBDS)
org: Florida Atlantic University
deadline_note: 2026 deadline was March 13, 2026 (rolling review from mid-December; last offers mid-April). 2027 dates not posted. NIH SIBS funding for 2027 is unconfirmed.
pay: Stipend (amount not stated; not a salary) + on-campus housing covered by the grant
eligibility: Undergraduates, or recent graduates not in graduate programs; 35-hour weeks for six weeks; outside work capped at 15 hours per week
summary: Six-week NIH SIBS site on FAU's Boca Raton campus covering biostatistics and data science training. Students then complete a research project.

title: ISI-BUDS: Summer Institute in Biostatistics and Data Science
org: University of California, Irvine
deadline_note: 2026 priority deadline was March 13, 2026 (rolling review; results from April 20). 2027 dates not posted. Funded under NIAID R25AI170491; 2027 SIBS funding unconfirmed.
pay: $1,000 stipend for incidentals + up to $500 travel + free housing with meal plan; no fees
eligibility: Undergraduates (see apply page for criteria); applicants from historically excluded groups strongly encouraged
summary: Six-week NIH-funded institute at UC Irvine that trains undergraduates in biostatistics and data science through coursework and research. Housing and meals are free.

title: Colorado Summer Institute in Biostatistics (CoSIBS)
org: University of Colorado Anschutz, Colorado School of Public Health
deadline_note: Page says applications are closed and program dates are TBA. Most recent dated info is from 2025. 2027 dates not posted; NHLBI funding for 2027 unconfirmed.
pay: $2,000 food stipend + room and board at Lynx Crossing (CU Denver); tuition, fees, and travel covered
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; undergraduates or early graduate students (at least 2 years of undergrad preferred); some programming, probability, calculus, and linear algebra; about 20 students
summary: NHLBI-funded residential summer institute in biostatistics and data science at CU Denver. Tuition, travel, and housing are covered.

title: Iowa Summer Institute in Biostatistics (ISIB)
org: University of Iowa College of Public Health
deadline_note: Rolling offers until filled; the application page says summer 2026 applications are closed. Stipend and dates on the About page are from 2024 (June 3 to July 19, 2024). 2027 dates not posted; NHLBI funding for 2027 unconfirmed.
dates: 2024: June 3 to July 19, 2024 (seven weeks); 2027 not posted
pay: Stipend after successful completion (amount not stated) + on-campus lodging, round-trip travel, and meal allowance; no fees
eligibility: Undergraduates; full criteria on the ISIB admissions criteria page
summary: Seven-week NIH/NHLBI-funded biostatistics institute at the University of Iowa. Lodging, travel, and meals are covered.

title: LA's BeST: Los Angeles Biostatistics and Data Science Summer Training
org: University of Southern California, Keck School of Medicine
deadline_note: Rolling review; decisions February to early May. 2026 deadline not stated on pages loaded. 2027 dates not posted. NHLBI R25 HL161788 funding for 2027 unconfirmed.
pay: $2,500 stipend + 2 USC credits; USC housing, transportation, and tuition covered
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; must have completed second year of undergrad before the program; May 2026 graduates and graduate students may also apply; housing mandatory
summary: Six-week NHLBI-funded biostatistics and data science program at USC with formal training and work on real data sets. About 14 to 16 trainees each summer.

title: UTMB Summer Institute in Biostatistics and Data Science (SIBDS)
org: University of Texas Medical Branch, School of Public and Population Health
deadline_note: 2026 deadline was March 15, 2026 (ongoing review). Portal closed. 2027 dates not posted; NHLBI R25HL161715 funding for 2027 unconfirmed.
pay: $3,160 stipend + up to $800 travel + housing; no fees or tuition
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; rising juniors and seniors, or graduates not yet in graduate school; GPA 3.0+; quantitative, computational, or math-focused biology majors
summary: Seven-week NHLBI-funded institute in Galveston with case-based instruction, computer labs, and mentored research. About 20 students per summer.

title: Big Data Summer Immersion at Yale (BDSY)
org: Yale School of Public Health
deadline_note: 2026 cycle ran Dec 15, 2025 to March 13, 2026, with decisions by April 1. 2027 dates not posted. NIH-funded slots for 2027 unconfirmed.
pay: Stipend for all participants (amount not stated) + housing in Yale residential colleges
eligibility: Undergraduates; NIH slots for US citizens and permanent residents; limited non-NIH scholarships for international students; priority to rising juniors and seniors
summary: Six-week summer immersion in big data and biostatistics at the Yale School of Public Health, launched in 2025. Participants live in Yale's residential colleges.

title: Big Data Summer Institute (BDSI)
org: University of Michigan School of Public Health
deadline_note: No deadline on the BDSI pages. The site shows 'All Applications Open!' but support details are for 2025. A 2022 news release says the NIH grant extends the program through 2027.
pay: $2,000 stipend (2025) + up to $500 travel + $200 dining credit + single-occupancy dorm (Couzens Hall)
eligibility: Undergraduates at accredited schools; SIBS slots for US citizens or permanent residents; limited Trehan Foundation and Rackham slots open to international students; coding, calculus, and basic statistics recommended
summary: In-person summer institute in Ann Arbor that introduces undergraduates to big data methods and health research through lectures and team projects.

title: Life Sciences Summer Undergraduate Research Program (LSSURP)
org: University of Minnesota Medical School
deadline_note: Main deadline Feb 1, 2027, midnight CT; Bio-LEAP deadline Feb 15, 2027. Not yet open as of Oct 16, 2026. The page lists the opening date as 'November 1, 2027,' likely a typo for 2026. Biostatistics is not a listed research area.
pay: $4,000 to $5,000 stipend; most programs cover on-campus housing, round-trip air travel, and a meal plan
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; full-time undergrad at a 2- or 4-year institution; interest in a life sciences graduate degree; no GPA minimum or prior research required
summary: Ten-week research program at the University of Minnesota across several life science areas, including heart, lung, and blood, and cancer. It prepares students for graduate study.

title: ACRES REU: Advanced Computational Research Experience
org: Michigan State University, ICER and Department of Computational Mathematics, Science and Engineering
deadline_note: 2026 application closed Feb 15, 2026; offers began the first week of March. 2027 dates not posted. Site directors are listed for Summer 2024 to 2027.
pay: $7,000 stipend + on-campus housing + meal plan (up to 200 meals) + travel up to $600
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; non-MSU undergraduates; GPA 3.0+; two semesters each of calculus and programming; must still be an undergraduate in the fall after the program
summary: NSF REU in computational and data science at MSU. Projects span computational biology, chemistry, mathematics, physics, and environmental data analytics.

title: Summer Research Opportunities Program (SROP)
org: Big Ten Academic Alliance
deadline_note: Application opens Nov 1, 2026 per apps.btaa.org (portal temporarily unavailable during migration). The How to Apply page lists a Feb 10 deadline without a year. 2027 deadline not confirmed.
dates: Varies by campus (e.g., Purdue 2026: June 7 to July 31, 2026)
pay: Varies by campus: $4,000 (Iowa, Maryland) to $6,000 to $7,200 (Rutgers); $6,500 Northwestern; $6,000 Ohio State; housing and travel covered at most sites
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; GPA 3.0+; at least 2 semesters completed and 1 remaining; strong interest in a PhD; no professional-degree students or graduates
summary: Mentored summer research at Big Ten universities through a single application. It prepares undergraduates for PhD study.

title: Summer Research Early Identification Program (SR-EIP)
org: The Leadership Alliance
deadline_note: 2026 deadline was Feb 3, 2026 (opened Nov 1, 2025). The page links a 2027 brochure but posts no 2027 dates.
dates: 8 to 10 weeks (AbbVie 11 weeks); 2026 sites ran roughly late May to mid-August
pay: Stipend (amount not stated) + travel and housing paid by host institution
eligibility: US citizens, non-citizen nationals, or permanent residents; full-time at accredited US institution; GPA 3.0+; at least 2 semesters completed and 1 remaining; intent to pursue PhD or MD-PhD; class year varies by site
summary: Paid summer research at member institutions such as Brown, Columbia, Harvard, Yale, and Penn. Students apply once to multiple sites.

title: NIH Summer Internship Program (SIP)
org: National Institutes of Health Intramural Research Program
deadline_note: Application closes Jan 26, 2027 at 12 p.m. ET; reference letters due Feb 2, 2027 at 12 p.m. ET.
dates: Must be completed between May 10 and August 31, 2027; exact dates set with PI (minimum 8 weeks full-time)
pay: Stipend adjusted annually by education level (see NIH stipends page); housing not provided
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; 18 by Sept 30, 2027 (exception for local HS seniors); enrolled at least half-time in college, university, or community college, or accepted to graduate school
summary: Full-time summer research in NIH intramural labs, including biostatistics, epidemiology, and computational groups. Applicants are selected directly by principal investigators.

title: Diversity Summer Internship Program for Undergraduates (DSIP)
org: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health
deadline_note: Summer 2027 applications will open in Fall 2026; deadline not posted. Decisions late March to mid-April.
pay: $3,000 stipend + housing for most students
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; degree-seeking at a US college with 2 years completed; recent graduates (within 2 years) not in grad school eligible; no graduate or HS students
summary: Eight-week public health research internship at the Bloomberg School with faculty mentors. Housing is provided on or near the Homewood campus.

title: Summer Undergraduate Mentored Research Program (SUMR)
org: University of Pennsylvania, Leonard Davis Institute of Health Economics
deadline_note: Application opened Oct 15, 2026; due Feb 1, 2027 at 11:59 PM. Interviews in March, notifications in April.
pay: $20/hour for 40 hours/week; discounted shared housing near campus (housing not provided)
eligibility: Rising sophomores, juniors, and seniors with interest in health care and strong quantitative skills; considering academic or research careers; first-generation and low-income students strongly encouraged; status of international students unclear on the page
summary: Twelve-week paid research program at Penn in health services research, population health, and clinical epidemiology. It focuses on health equity.

title: CDC John R. Lewis Undergraduate Public Health Scholars Program
org: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (with partner institutions)
deadline_note: Applications open each fall; exact dates vary by partner program. The CDC page (updated Sept 21, 2026) describes the program as active but lists no deadlines.
eligibility: Undergraduate and recently graduated students; seven partner institutions run separate applications with their own criteria
summary: CDC-funded public health training delivered through seven partner institutions, each with its own application. The CDC page gives no stipend details.

title: Pediatric Oncology Education (POE) Program
org: St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
deadline_note: Opens Nov 1, 2026. Submit by mid-to-late December recommended; applications after Jan 1 risk missing the deadline.
dates: Start May 10, May 17, May 24, or June 1, 2027; 11 weeks for undergraduates
pay: $600/week subsistence allowance + free group housing for non-Memphis students; travel not covered
eligibility: US citizen, non-citizen national, or permanent resident; full-time at a US school; GPA 3.4+ overall and in science/math; prior research experience; completed sophomore year
summary: Paid summer research at St. Jude in which Biostatistics and Computational Biology are listed participating departments. Group housing is free for students from outside Memphis.

title: Summer Program in Cancer Research (SPCR)
org: UT MD Anderson Cancer Center
deadline_note: Applications open Nov 16, 2026 and close Jan 13, 2027, including reference letters. Acceptance notices late February 2027.
pay: Up to $7,200 pre-tax stipend; no on-site housing
eligibility: US undergraduates who are freshmen, sophomores, or juniors in spring 2027 at a US institution; spring 2027 graduates not eligible; full 10-week commitment
summary: NCI-sponsored 10-week cancer research program at MD Anderson. Computational and systems biology is cited as a faculty research strength.

title: CPRIT CURE Summer Undergraduate Program
org: UT MD Anderson Cancer Center
deadline_note: Page lists opening Nov 16 and closing Jan 13 at 11:59pm CST without a year; dates assumed to be 2026 to 2027 for the summer 2027 cycle.
pay: Up to $7,200 stipend covering living, housing, and travel
eligibility: Students finishing freshman, sophomore, or junior year by June 2027, or fifth-year seniors returning fall 2027; international students with valid visa eligible; physics, math, and CS students especially encouraged
summary: Paid 10-week cancer research program at MD Anderson open to undergraduates of all majors, with a stated interest in quantitative backgrounds. International students with a valid visa are eligible.

title: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
org: Fred Hutch Cancer Center
deadline_note: 2027 application expected mid-to-late November 2026; deadline not posted. 2026 applicants were notified by mid-March 2026.
dates: Nine weeks, summer 2027 (dates on Program Schedule page)
pay: $7,304 stipend + travel up to $450; interns pay housing (about $3,300, 2025 estimate)
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; entering the summer before final year of undergrad; strong science background
summary: Nine-week paid research program at Fred Hutch. Placements include statistical and epidemiological work in Public Health Sciences and computational research in other divisions.

title: Amgen Scholars Program (U.S.)
org: Amgen Foundation with 14 host institutions
deadline_note: Feb 1, 2027 for all US host sites; separate application per site. US applications open Nov 1. Notification by end of March.
dates: 8 to 10 weeks, typically June through August; site dates TBA
pay: Financial support varies by site (amounts not stated); symposium room and board covered
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; sophomores (with 4 quarters or 3 semesters completed), juniors, or non-graduating seniors at accredited 4-year US institutions; GPA 3.2+; interest in PhD or MD-PhD
summary: Summer research at 14 US host sites including Johns Hopkins, UNC Chapel Hill, Duke, Columbia, Harvard, and Yale. A national symposium is included.

title: Computational Statistics REU: Complex Data Analysis Using Statistical and Machine Learning Tools
org: University of North Carolina at Greensboro
deadline_note: 2026 deadline was April 1, 2026. Page says program funding status is pending at the NSF. 2027 dates not posted.
pay: $6,000 stipend ($600/week) + $2,240 on-campus housing + $600 meals + $300 working meals; competitive $1,100 travel support
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; 30+ credits by end of spring; GPA 3.0+; probability/statistics, calculus, and some programming
summary: Ten-week NSF REU in computational statistics and machine learning for complex data. Funding for the next cycle is pending at NSF.

title: Summer Internships for Undergraduates
org: Vanderbilt University Medical Center, Department of Biostatistics
deadline_note: 2026 window closed Feb 23, 2026. Page says to check back in early 2027. 2027 dates not posted.
pay: Up to $4,000 stipend; housing not included
eligibility: US citizens or permanent residents; completed at least one year of program; graduating no earlier than December 2026 (2026 cycle)
summary: Six-week biostatistics internship run by Vanderbilt's Department of Biostatistics, now in its fifth year. Housing is not included.

title: Duke Supporting Undergraduate Research Experiences (SURE) Program
org: Duke Clinical and Translational Science Institute
deadline_note: 2026 applications accepted Jan 1 to Feb 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted. Page does not say explicitly whether non-Duke students are eligible.
pay: $6,000 stipend + funding for a scientific meeting; housing and travel for non-local students
eligibility: Full-time undergrads entering sophomore, junior, or senior year; strong academics; US citizens or valid visa holders (F-1, J-1, H1B, PR, TN listed)
summary: Ten-week mentored research program at Duke focused on cardiovascular research and medicine. It ends with a symposium.

title: Broad Summer Research Program (BSRP)
org: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard
deadline_note: Application opens end of October 2026; due Jan 10, 2027 at 11:59 PM ET; letters due Jan 11, 2027. Notifications by mid-March.
pay: $5,400 stipend + paid housing + domestic travel to Boston
eligibility: Enrolled at a 4-year US college in Fall 2026, graduating Dec 2027 or later; STEM major; GPA 3.2+; interest in PhD or MD-PhD; US work authorization (no visa sponsorship)
summary: Nine-week research program at the Broad Institute with computational or experimental projects. Areas include population genetics, data sciences, and machine learning.

title: Summer Student Program (SSP)
org: The Jackson Laboratory
location: Bar Harbor, ME or Farmington, CT
deadline_note: Applications open in November; due Jan 25, 2027 at 5:00 p.m. ET.
pay: $7,500 stipend + room, board, and travel
eligibility: Undergraduates from across the US interested in genetics and genomics; official criteria on JAX admissions page
summary: Ten-week independent research program in genetics and genomics at JAX. Bar Harbor is residential and Farmington is not.

title: Undergraduate Research Program (URP)
org: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory
deadline_note: Applications open; due Jan 15, 2027, 11:59 pm PST, with both letters. Notification by end of March.
pay: $7,000 stipend + room and board
eligibility: Current sophomores and juniors; must return to undergrad after summer; strong science background (CS, math, physics encouraged); NSF REU slots for US citizens/permanent residents; international students eligible for other fellowships
summary: Summer research at CSHL with a Bioinformatics and Computational Neuroscience track. Computational mentors work in genomics and machine learning.

title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
org: Mayo Clinic Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences
location: Rochester, MN; Scottsdale, AZ; Jacksonville, FL
deadline_note: Application window Nov 1, 2026 to Feb 3, 2027; one application per season.
pay: $7,000 stipend for 10 weeks; housing not included (options and costs listed)
eligibility: Enrolled at accredited US college; completed sophomore year; not graduating before program; GPA 3.0+; international students with CPT/OPT eligible; considering PhD or MD-PhD
summary: Ten-week paid biomedical research fellowship at three Mayo Clinic campuses. Fellows choose a research area and are matched with a mentor.
